name: Danny
summary: Danny is the retired deputy director of NCSA, a very blunt and no-nonsense Texan who is not to be messed with.

source.parsed_text:
Danny is the retired deputy director of NCSA and very very Texan.  He is not someone to be messed with, and he is very blunt to folks that annoy him.


Special moves:
- Defunded, he takes all of your funding away and tells you "you should have gotten it in writing!"
- Wranglin time, he hops on a horse, puts on a cowboy had, lassos you, causing you to be unable to move for a while.

inferred_stats.reason: Retired director with tough, no-nonsense Texan resilience and experienced composure.

expressions.victory: smug chuckle with an eyebrows raise

victory_pose: Danny adjusts his belt buckle, tips his cowboy hat, and crosses his arms with a stern nod.
taunts: You should've gotten that in writing!
I'm too old for this nonsense.
